metadata.name: Cinematic2Def

members.name: AtmospherePath
members.description: Specifies the atmosphere to use during the cinematic.

members.name: PreviewLightingZonePath
members.description: Zone used for previewing lighting conditions in the cine-editor (if different from the lighting zone used in project.set). This field has no impact in game.

members.name: PreviewLightingCondition
members.description: Default lighting condition used by the cine-editor. This field has no impact in game.

members.name: Looping
members.description: Specifies whether or not the cinematic loops.

members.name: Letterboxed
members.description: Specifies whether or not the cinematic is letterboxed at 2.4 aspect ratio.

members.name: EnableStreaming
members.description: Specifies whether to stream the animation data.

members.name: IsQte
members.description: Specifies this is a QTE (gameplay driven) cinematic.

members.name: Skippable
members.description: Allows cinematic to be skipped in game.

members.name: ResetOnFinished
members.description: When cinematic finishes, reinitialize to ready state. Enable this if want a cine to get back to ready state after finishing.

members.name: MayaPlayBackCompensate
members.description: When music is scored with maya play back for i29 and i31

members.name: OnEnterCameraTransitionDuration
members.description: Specifies the transition from the game camera to the cinematic camera when the cinematic starts.

members.name: OnExitCameraTransitionDuration
members.description: Specifies the transition from the cinematic camera to the game camera when the cinematic ends.

members.name: AspectBlurVisible
members.description: From what aspect ratio should the aspect blur be visible? When -1 defaults to 32/9

members.name: AspectBlurStart
members.description: At what aspect ratio should the aspect blur start? When -1, defaults to 25/9

members.name: AspectBlurEnd
members.description: At what aspect ratio should the aspect blur be at its maximum? When -1, defaults to 32/9

members.name: AspectBlurRadius
members.description: What should the radius of the aspect blur be in pixels? When -1, defaults to 100 pixels. When 0, fades to black. For each pixel 2 taps are done.

members.name: Tags
members.description: A set of gameplay-defined values used when processing this cine.

members.name: RunGameOptions
members.description: Options to automatically populate in the Tools Hub's Run Game panel when clicking Run Game from the Cinematic Editor or from the Asset Editor with a Cinematic open.

members.name: ActorCustomizationConfig
members.description: This specifies the Hero customization config file.

values.name: Unload

values.name: ExitLoop
values.description: All looping animations finish and move on

values.name: SetToEndAndHide
values.description: Set the cinematic to end state -- deactivates possessed actors

path_forward: Preserve current diagnostics as raw candidates; phase and callable capability remain false.
Bind one actual mission cinematic using resource metadata plus owner/action/scene identity, accounting for the menu counterexample.
Close Skippable definition conversion to the resource native flag and confirm the current callback slot value without executing it.
Future authorized passive native-call instrumentation can record the complete UI/166C7F0 entry, caller thread and object lifetime before designing a game-thread command queue.
Only after controlled native skip and natural end traces prove mission/door/enemy/checkpoint cleanup should a co-op skip adapter be enabled.
